title: pi-gwn-tec: code for Physics inspired graph learning for ionospheric total electron content forecasting
description: Source code for the article Physics inspired graph learning for ionospheric total electron content forecasting (Xiong et al.): Graph WaveNet predictors, physics-inspired training objectives, model configurations for every table and figure, evaluation, calibration, statistics and figure-generation routines. Data are archived separately; see README.md.
